# Scoutro brand assets

Replace the files here to change the logo, favicon or colors. Keep the file
names; the templates reference them directly.

| File | Size | Used as |
|---|---|---|
| `icon-32.png` | 32×32 | favicon |
| `icon-180.png` | 180×180 | `apple-touch-icon` |
| `icon-192.png` | 192×192 | large icon (manifest / Olares) |
| `icon-64.png` | 64×64 | app tile |
| `mascot-64.png`, `mascot-128.png` | 64×64, 128×128, transparent | logo in the admin header and the search navbar |
| `mascot-480.webp` | 480×480, transparent | start page hero (rendered at 240px) |
| `pose-question.webp` | 240×283, transparent | results page empty state |
| `pose-wave.webp` | 240×318, transparent | About page header |
| `pose-laptop.webp` | 240×262, transparent | About page, administration links |
| `brand.css` | – | color, shape and type tokens (`--scoutro-*`) |

Source artwork: the Scoutro app icon, the mascot-in-magnifier artwork and
the mascot pose sheet provided by the Scoutro project (2026). The images were cropped and scaled
for the web; the originals are not part of the repository. They are
placeholders until the final Scoutro logo is delivered.
